nodes.text: @fengyunshe HMPV virus outbreak, Western experts call on the CCP to be transparent As human metapneumovirus ravages China, cases have doubled in the United States, but the CCP downplayed the respiratory infection, saying it was "less severe" and "smaller" than last year.
